description: Returns the receipt of a transaction by transaction hash.

object.description: A transaction receipt object, or null when the transaction is not available

object.blockHash.description: The hash of the block where this transaction was in

object.blockNumber.description: The block number where this transaction was added encoded as a hexadecimal

object.contractAddress.description: The contract address created for contract creation, otherwise null

object.cumulativeGasUsed.description: The total gas used when this transaction was executed in the block

object.effectiveGasPrice.description: The total base charge plus tip paid for each unit of gas

object.gasUsed.description: The amount of gas used by this specific transaction alone

object.logs.description: An array of log objects that generated this transaction

object.logs.address.description: The address from which this log was generated

object.logs.topics.description: An array of zero to four 32 Bytes DATA of indexed log arguments. In Solidity, the first topic is the hash of the signature of the event (e.g. Deposit(address, bytes32, uint256)), except you declare the event with the anonymous specifier

object.logs.data.description: The 32 byte non-indexed argument of the log

object.logs.blockNumber.description: The block number where this log was in

object.logs.transactionHash.description: The hash of the transaction from which this log was created from. null if the log is pending

object.logs.transactionIndex.description: The transactions index position from which this log was created from. null if the log is pending

object.logs.blockHash.description: The hash of the block where this log was in

object.logs.logIndex.description: The integer of log index position in the block encoded as hexadecimal. null if the log is pending

object.logs.removed.description: It is true if log was removed, due to a chain reorganization and false if it's a valid log

object.logsBloom.description: The bloom filter which is used to retrive related logs

object.status.description: It is either 1 (success) or 0 (failure) encoded as a hexadecimal

object.to.description: The address of the receiver. Null when its a contract creation transaction

object.transactionIndex.description: The transactions index position in the block encoded as a hexadecimal
